sources.quote: Omicron Geminorum, also named Jishui, is a solitary star in the constellation of Gemini.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.9 solar radii and 1.96 solar masses (FLAME) and 6,470 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
